# Flasqo

> Flasqo is a free AI-powered API testing platform by EvoluneEdgeTech. Paste an API URL and it auto-discovers endpoints and generates a complete test suite — functional, smoke, performance/load, regression, contract, GraphQL, fuzz and chaos testing — in one browser-based dashboard. No manual test-script writing is required.

Key facts:
- Free to use, no credit card required; runs in the browser at https://flasqo.com/
- AI generates 10–100 test cases per endpoint: happy-path, edge-case, negative and security tests
- 13 testing modules: functional, smoke, performance (load/stress/spike/endurance), chaos engineering, fuzz, regression, contract, GraphQL, integration flows, API auto-discovery, natural-language "vibe testing", a visual flow builder and a production deploy gate
- Supports Bearer token, API key and Basic authentication
- Exports JSON/PDF reports and saves results to GitHub via built-in integration
- Positioned as an all-in-one alternative to combining Postman (manual collections), JMeter (load) and custom chaos/fuzz scripts

## Core pages

- [Home](https://flasqo.com/): product overview, feature list, comparison table and FAQ
- [What is API testing?](https://flasqo.com/guides/api-testing/): pillar guide covering all API testing types
- [API load testing guide](https://flasqo.com/guides/api-load-testing/): load, stress, spike and endurance testing explained
- [API chaos testing guide](https://flasqo.com/guides/api-chaos-testing/): chaos engineering for APIs — latency injection, failure simulation
- [API contract testing guide](https://flasqo.com/guides/api-contract-testing/): schema drift and consumer-breaking changes
- [GraphQL API testing guide](https://flasqo.com/guides/graphql-api-testing/): testing queries and mutations
